subject: Signoff needed: tailored bundling & 35% TAC-2 discount for MedCampus POC
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-02 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signoff needed: tailored bundling & 35% TAC-2 discount for MedCampus POC

Team,

Quick summary: MedCampus (large regional healthcare system) is asking for a time‑boxed POC that bundles Redwood Dedicated capacity + Private deployment connectivity for a 6‑month pilot. They are pushing for a 35% concession off our TAC‑2 packaged list price for the pilot in order to justify internal approval.

Why this is a special case:
- They are consolidating three care ML features into one integration, which increases expected token throughput and KV cache usage (higher ops burden).
- If successful, this sale converts to a 36‑month enterprise contract with estimated committed spend ~ $1.2M/year.
- Competitive pressure: they are evaluating two alternatives that have offered deeper short‑term discounts but lower performance SLAs.

Numbers (requested):
- List TAC‑2 POC bundle (standard): $60,000/month
- MedCampus requested: 35% off -> $39,000/month for 6 months (total $234k)
- Risk-adjusted net revenue over 36 months if converted (conservative): ~$2.6M

Request: I need VP/CFO signoff to grant the 35% deviation for this specific POC, conditional on:
1) Signed PoC SOW with explicit success criteria and go/no-go milestone at month 4.
2) Non‑recurring setup fee (one‑time) to cover VPC connectivity work ($18k).
3) Clause: if conversion occurs, discount resets to standard enterprise tier and we backfill revenue via an implementation credit applied to first invoice.

Attached: medcampus_pricing_v3.xlsx (pricing breakdown), medcampus_poc_scope.docx (SOW draft), po-template.pdf (procurement template).

Suggested memo language for CFO signoff (short):
"Approve a one‑time 35% promotional discount on TAC‑2 bundle for MedCampus Health POC (6 months) subject to SOW milestones, a $18k non‑recurring connectivity fee, and mandatory conversion pricing reversion. Expected long‑term upside justifies temporary margin concession."

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa: validate finance impact and any tax/recognition hurdles.
- Vivek/Jasmine: if approved, we push for PO + DocuSign this week.

Thanks — I can be on standby to join the customer call at 12:30 PT to secure verbal agreement if we get signoff.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: medcampus_pricing_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: medcampus_poc_scope.docx (doc)]
[Attachment: po-template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signoff needed: tailored bundling & 35% TAC-2 discount for MedCampus POC

Irene — thanks for the concise summary and the suggested memo. A few notes before I would sign off to Finance/CFO: 

1) Can you add an explicit KPI table in the SOW that quantifies the cost to us if the POC runs beyond the 6 months (e.g., support/ops uplift per month)? Finance will want to see the potential downside.
2) I prefer approving up to 30% as our guideline unless Vivek wants to make a commercial exception. If there is a compelling competitive reason and a solid conversion trigger, 35% may be justified, but it should be escalated to CFO for final signoff (per policy).
3) Make the non‑recurring connectivity fee non‑waivable and require procurement to issue a PO that covers it up front.

Irene: please prepare a 1‑page impact memo (one paragraph revenue upside, one paragraph downside/costs, and final ask) so I can attach it to the CFO note. If you can get a verbal from Dr. Rao on the milestone language today, that would help.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signoff needed: tailored bundling & 35% TAC-2 discount for MedCampus POC

Adding context from my side after the discovery call with Priya this morning:
- MedCampus is under a compressed procurement timeline (internal board review mid‑Sep). If we can commit to a locked POC price today, it materially increases our chance to win.
- Their security team requires Private deployment for EHR adjacency — that increases onboarding time but also raises switching costs for them.

Commercial recommendation: Approve an exception up to 33% today conditional on:
- 6‑month POC, paid monthly, PO upfront for month 1,
- $18k connectivity fee paid on PO,
- Exec sponsor confirmation via email (we got a verbal from Dr. Rao earlier),
- A conversion clause: if they sign for 36 months within 90 days of POC end, we credit the connectivity fee and apply enterprise pricing (no retroactive deeper discount).

I've uploaded a slightly edited PO template (po-template.pdf) and a redline to the pricing workbook that sets an upper cap on total lifetime discount exposure. If Finance pushes back on 33%, I'm okay escalating 35% to the CFO with the exact memo Marissa requested.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: po-template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signoff needed: tailored bundling & 35% TAC-2 discount for MedCampus POC

Team — I reviewed the numbers and the strategic context. I approve making a commercial exception for this specific POC up to 35% with the conditions you outlined (Irene/Jasmine): fixed 6‑month term, $18k non‑recurring connectivity fee, PO for month 1 up front, and the conversion clause.

However, per our pricing governance I need a short CFO memo with the following before I will sign the commercial deviation form:
- One‑page impact memo (Marissa requested) attached to the deviation form
- Explicit statement of expected ARR uplift if conversion occurs and sensitivity for 0/25/50/100% conversion outcomes
- Confirmation from Sales Legal that SOW language limits scope and liability for extended KV/cache usage beyond the pilot

Irene — please prepare the 1‑page memo (I can review by EOD Fri) and loop in Finance (cc: finance-approvals@redwood.com) when you submit. If Finance signs off, I will countersign the deviation and instruct Legal to finalize the PoC SOW.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Commercial
Redwood Inference
[Inline note: I'll join the procurement call at 3pm PT Thursday if helpful]
